cases.name: ebox-shared-scopes-reorder-keeps-current-colors
cases.purpose: Reordering retained nodes preserves current slot and fallback colors.

cases.name: ebox-viewport-height-keeps-frame-reference-through-updates
cases.purpose: Nested viewport heights and arithmetic follow frame resize and retained updates.

cases.name: ebox-viewport-height-constrains-flex-minima-maxima-and-basis
cases.purpose: Column Flex constraints retain their original viewport reference.

cases.name: ebox-scroll-containers-compose-through-layout-and-updates
cases.purpose: Nested and sibling scrolling containers compose in Column and Flex and retain independent visible content through updates and resize.

cases.name: ebox-shared-scopes-insertion-keeps-current-inheritance-and-membership
cases.purpose: Sibling insertion preserves scoped paint while later rule, membership and ancestry changes update the visible result.

cases.name: ebox-drag-follows-keyed-owner-and-publishes-release
cases.purpose: Movement and release retain the keyed target across visible reordering.

cases.name: ebox-drag-cancels-disabled-target-and-preserves-unrelated-input
cases.purpose: Disabling the target ends tracking; unrelated input returns to Emacs.

cases.name: ebox-drag-cancels-when-leaving-the-original-window
cases.purpose: Leaving the original text window cancels the gesture.

cases.name: ebox-drag-releases-removed-owners-and-lost-windows
cases.purpose: Removed targets, unmount and switched windows release active tracking.

cases.name: ebox-nested-flex-keeps-current-content-and-viewport
cases.purpose: Nested Flex keeps current wrapping, sibling placement and output width through content updates and viewport changes.

cases.name: ebox-primary-press-uses-replaced-mouse-binding
cases.purpose: A held retained target activates its newly accepted explicit mouse callback instead of a stale callback or keyboard binding.

cases.name: ebox-primary-press-keeps-pure-text-activation
cases.purpose: Generated maps remain usable on pure rendered text without mounting a retained surface.

cases.name: ebox-primary-press-clears-active-when-target-is-clipped
cases.purpose: Clipping a held target clears its selector state in the same visible publication and cancels activation.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-compose-layout-interaction-and-content
cases.purpose: Layout and native interaction changes preserve child content updates, editable handles and snapshot parity.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-compose-with-range-reorder
cases.purpose: Parent property changes compose with Range reordering in either order while retaining focus and editable child handles.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-preserve-text-and-structural-ownership
cases.purpose: Property updates preserve text, refine retained structural replacements and do not resurrect removed owners.

cases.name: ebox-host-properties-update-selector-facts-and-rules
cases.purpose: Class changes and rule replacement/removal restyle retained descendants through the shared cascade.

cases.name: ebox-range-reorders-preserve-nested-updates-and-focus
cases.purpose: Keyed and unkeyed source identities preserve focus, published content and subsequent nested Range updates through reorder, insertion and removal.

cases.name: ebox-focus-within-navigates-retained-subtrees
cases.purpose: Scoped focus navigates eligible controls, wraps within a panel and follows keyed reorder without changing global focus authority.

cases.name: ebox-focus-within-rejects-unavailable-and-unaccepted-targets
cases.purpose: Invalid, hidden, unmounted and provisional focus roots reject movement while preserving accepted focus and point.

cases.name: ebox-focus-retains-local-facts-and-structural-inheritance
cases.purpose: Repeated focus transitions and intervening content updates preserve current selector facts, inherited local paint and structural sibling/descendant rules.

cases.name: ebox-responsive-cache-keeps-current-containing-size
cases.purpose: Percentage-sized paint follows containing width and height across repeated resizes and unrelated content publications without stale cache reuse.

cases.name: ebox-responsive-cache-preserves-cyclic-native-keymaps
cases.purpose: Responsive subtrees mount with a recursive native keymap, retain activation across unrelated updates and use a newly published replacement binding.

cases.name: ebox-flex-progress-updates-preserve-fractional-sibling-geometry
cases.purpose: Repeated simultaneous progress width and label updates retain sibling pixel geometry and enclosing paint, matching a fresh render after parent size and color changes.

cases.name: ebox-focus-state-only-observation-keeps-independent-inputs
cases.purpose: Repeated state-only focus updates retain independent mounts and pure input while public exclusive phase timings account for the whole observed commit.

cases.name: ebox-layer-source-intervals-preserve-unicode-and-properties
cases.purpose: Layer show/hide updates preserve untouched CJK and combining glyphs, native properties and caller inputs.

cases.name: ebox-layer-flow-z-order-can-cross-overlay
cases.purpose: Changing normal-flow z order across a positioned overlay preserves the correct visible winner through repeated commits.
